Designed for those who value health, relaxation, and efficiency in limited space, the Dynamic Saunas Gracia Edition (Model DYN-6119-01) delivers full-spectrum infrared therapy in a compact footprint—perfect for apartments, condos, and smaller wellness retreats. Built with natural reforested Canadian Hemlock wood, this 1–2 person infrared sauna brings spa-quality rejuvenation into your home, combining near zero EMF technology with eco-conscious craftsmanship.

Featuring 6 strategically placed FAR infrared carbon heating panels, the Gracia sauna spreads heat evenly across the bench and floor. The soft-touch control panel with LED display makes it easy to adjust temperature and session duration. A built-in MP3 auxiliary connection lets you enjoy soothing music while the interior chromotherapy lighting enhances the ambiance.

The Gracia model is designed to plug into any standard 120V household outlet—making installation easy with no electrical upgrades required. If you're seeking a premium wellness upgrade in a smaller footprint, the DYN-6119-01 Gracia is your go-to compact sauna solution.
